scope: original-only; no candidate, no mesh, no PDE or material changes
method: project source 3D gas-face centroid onto tab source line/arc centerline; bounded nearest-section distance, contact-centered path; 1D source thermal nodes and distributed Joule parabolic solution with explicit endpoint weights; unresolvable or outside contact interval flagged, no invented temperature
gates: unique 1840 face tags and exact area conservation
tab projection within half thickness plus audited tolerance and 3D width
strict identity of source segments, path lengths, Cu node sources and endpoint contacts
negative control rejects distant/off-curve, unknown node and out-of-span
endpoint exact, 1D ODE and energy conservation
no implicit isothermal net; net88 midpoint remains thermal-only
any supplemental gas link requires original-source finite facing geometry plus independent obstruction and unique disjoint area; otherwise STOP no solve
film_assumptions: selected engineering conductivity range and thermal flux for algebraic resistance demonstration only, no inference of contact conductance
budgets: at most one full solve only after actual original face geometry and conservative gas path pass; 300s/4CPU/8GiB; no variant computation
release: tests, immutable archives, additive report and reproducibility; no claim full cavity validated
